decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - 1		NSTD2	The premises shall be occupied only as cosmetic surgery treatment/consultation as described in the application 00248/93A/P2 and for no other purpose, including any other D1 use, without the prior permission of the Local Planning Authority. Upon the cessation of the use of the premises for the purpose hereby permitted the use of the premises, unless otherwise permitted, shall revert to those permitted under B1.
description: Change of 1st, 2nd and 3rd floors from offices (B1) to (D1) consultation/treatment room and (B1) office use
